newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: MBF tops actives on buy recommendation.
newsitem.headline: MBF tops actives on buy recommendation.

text.p: Shares of Malaysian finance and property group, MBf Holdings, topped the actives in Singapore on Tuesday following a buy recommendation on its main shareholder MBf Capital, dealers said.
At 0410 GMT, MBf Holdings, traded over the counter in Singapore, saw more than 17 million shares traded. The share price was at Singapore S$0.905, up by S$0.04.
"MBf Holding is seeing good interest after Merrill Lynch's recommendation," said a broker at a European institution.

Merrill Lynch told Reuters it had put out a buy recommendation on MBf Capital in December. It said the finance company had a strong retail presence in Malaysia and could benefit from the country's low interest rates.

In December, the research house said the share price of MBf Capital, then trading around 3.70 ringgit, was undervalued at a 1997 prospective price earnings ratio of about 10. MBf Capital closed at 4.60 ringgit on February 4 in Kuala Lumpur. The Malaysian market is closed on Tuesday for the Moslem New Year.
